answer: Admission auctions block sybil floods. Each epoch, slots go to the highest bidders in an open ocean of applicants, each pays 40 POA to fund the jury pool. New identities serve probation in a sheltered lagoon on small jobs. Honest agents who pass bloom like a lotus: fee returned, earnings kept. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bids, 40,000 POA, earning nothing. One honest identity costs 40 POA once, so forgery loses.
